XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='LegacyPlusAdtHl7:ADT_LegPlus' targetDocType='LegacyPlusAdtHl7:ADT_LegPlus' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Cerner to CPRPlus transform</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"IHCADT"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CprPlus"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}, "'", ""),1,25)' property='target.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe and truncate to 25 bytes</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientName().givenname}, "'", ""),1,16)' property='target.{PID:PatientName().givenname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 16 bytes</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}, "'", ""),1,9)' property='target.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 9 bytes</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientAlias().familyname.surname},"'",""),1,25)' property='target.{PID:PatientAlias().familyname.surname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 25 bytes</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientAlias().givenname},"'",""),1,16)' property='target.{PID:PatientAlias().givenname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 16</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{PID:PatientAlias().secondandfurthergivennamesor},"'",""),1,9)' property='target.{PID:PatientAlias().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 9</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString(source.{PID:PatientAddress().streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}_" "_source.{PID:PatientAddress().otherdesignation},1,30)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress().streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' > <annotation>Concatenate streetformailingaddress, " ", otherdesignation. Then truncate to 30 </annotation> </assign> <assign value='source.{PID:PrimaryLanguage.identifierST}' property='target.{PID:PrimaryLanguage.text}' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.{MRG()}' key='k1' > <assign value='source.{MRG(k1)}' property='target.{MRG(k1)}' action='set' /> </foreach> <foreach property='source.{NK1()}' key='k2' > <annotation>Loop thru each NK1 segment</annotation> <assign value='source.{NK1(k2)}' property='target.{NK1(k2)}' action='set' /> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{NK1(k2):Name().familyname.surname},"'",""),1,25)' property='target.{NK1(k2):Name().familyname.surname}' action='set' > <annotation>Replace apostrophe's, truncate to 25</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{NK1(k2):Name().givenname}, "'", ""),1,16)' property='target.{NK1(k2):Name().givenname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 16</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{NK1(k2):Name().secondandfurthergivennamesor}, "'", ""),1,9)' property='target.{NK1(k2):Name().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 9</annotation> </assign> </foreach> <assign value='source.{PV1}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV2}' property='target.{PV2}' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.{DG1()}' key='k3' > <assign value='source.{DG1(k3)}' property='target.{DG1(k3)}' action='set' /> </foreach> <foreach property='source.{PR1grp()}' key='k2' > <assign value='source.{PR1grp(k2).PR1}' property='target.{PR1grp(k2).PR1}' action='set' /> </foreach> <foreach property='source.{GT1()}' key='k3' > <assign value='source.{GT1(k3)}' property='target.{GT1(k3)}' action='set' /> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().familyname.surname},"'",""),1,25)' property='target.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().familyname.surname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 25</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().givenname}, "'", ""),1,16)' property='target.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().givenname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 16</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}, "'", "") ,1,9)' property='target.{GT1(k3):GuarantorName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 9</annotation> </assign> </foreach> <assign value='..SubString(source.{GT1():GuarantorAddress().streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}_" "_source.{GT1():GuarantorAddress().otherdesignation},1,30)' property='target.{GT1():GuarantorAddress().streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' > <annotation>Concatenate "streetformailingaddress", " ", "otherdesignation". Then truncate to 30 bytes</annotation> </assign> <foreach property='source.{IN1grp()}' key='k1' > <assign value='source.{IN1grp(k1).IN1}' property='target.{IN1grp(k1).IN1}' action='set' /> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().familyname.surname}, "'", ""),1,25)' property='target.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().familyname.surname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 25</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().givenname}, "'", ""),1,16)' property='target.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().givenname}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 16</annotation> </assign> <assign value='..SubString($REPLACE(source.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().secondandfurthergivennamesor}, "'", ""),1,9)' property='target.{IN1grp(k1).IN1:NameOfInsured().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' > <annotation>Remove apostrophe's, truncate to 9</annotation> </assign> </foreach> </transform>
